scripts.check: pnpm run check:shell && pnpm run check:ps && pnpm run check:js && pnpm run check:md
scripts.check:shell: uvx --from shellcheck-py shellcheck -s sh src/termux/termux_touch.sh src/termux/install.sh src/shared/start_touch.sh
scripts.check:ps: powershell -NoProfile -File scripts/format_ps.ps1 -Check && powershell -NoProfile -Command "Invoke-ScriptAnalyzer -Path src/windows/src -Recurse -Settings ./PSScriptAnalyzerSettings.psd1; Invoke-ScriptAnalyzer -Path scripts -Recurse -Settings ./PSScriptAnalyzerSettings.psd1"
